Captured 13 November 2026 Brisbane from the rendered completed response and expanded visible top-level activity.

Capture limits: native final ID, text, prefix and database byte identity are unknown; rendered math and tables may have gaps. Nested commands, web, file and subagent views were not read. Linked report, code, PDF and ZIP were not collected; their identity and transfer eligibility are unverified. No private hidden reasoning was requested or reconstructed.

## Available rendered final

Result

I developed a specific removal mechanism, a complete process construction, and an executable campaign and factory model. I cannot honestly call the result the economical, qualified reuse operation you requested. The constructed reference case misses the capital, service-cost and campaign-energy targets substantially. Its potentially useful invention is a support-transfer mechanism that releases the original joint one lamination at a time while continuously supporting the brittle magnets.

The work also exposes two independent obstacles: the selected rotor’s proprietary material and bonding details remain insufficiently characterized, and its available population cannot sustain the requested single-family industrial throughput for 20 years.
